title: Why AI Prices Have Dropped 100x in Two Years
summary: The cost of running frontier AI has fallen faster than almost any technology in computing history. GPT-3's 2020 pricing would cost roughly $20 for the same task that costs $0.002 today. Here's what drove it and what it changes.
